title: PolyA/polyQ-mediated conformational rewiring regulates DNA engagement and drives aggregation in the neuronal transcription factor Ascl1
authors: Shrutarshi Mitra; Sarah F. Ruidiaz; Ásdís H.V. Laufeyjardóttir; Vasileios Voutsinos; Kateryna Nitsenko; Andrea Guala; Kenneth S. Zaret; Rasmus Hartmann-Petersen; Pétur O. Heidarsson
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单分子FRET研究神经元转录因子Ascl1的构象动态，揭示polyA/polyQ无序区调控非特异性DNA结合与聚集，虽聚焦TF-DNA互作但方法为实验而非AI/物理模拟，故为中档匹配。
abstract: Ascl1 is a pioneer transcription factor that drives neuronal fate decisions, yet the structural basis of its activity remains elusive. Besides the basic helix–loop–helix (bHLH) domain which dimerizes with other transcription factors and binds DNA, Ascl1 contains long low-complexity intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs), including a polyA/polyQ tract of unknown function. Here we use single-molecule FRET to map the conformational ensemble of full-length Ascl1 across monomeric, heterodimeric, and DNA-bound states. Monomeric Ascl1 is largely disordered but displays multivalent coupling between the N-terminal IDR and the bHLH domain, with the polyA/polyQ tract opposing bHLH compaction. E12 binding folds the bHLH domain and remodels the N-IDR, increasing dynamics across the N-IDR while suppressing them locally within the polyA/polyQ tract. Deleting the tract weakens nonspecific DNA binding by the Ascl1/E12 heterodimer without disrupting heterodimerization or high-affinity E-box binding, abolishes aggregation in vitro, and increases Ascl1 abundance in HEK293T cells. Thus, the polyA/polyQ tract acts as a regulatory module that promotes nonspecific DNA engagement while imposing a cost in solubility and cellular abundance.
abstract_zh: Ascl1是一种先驱转录因子，驱动神经元命运决定，但其活性的结构基础仍不清楚。除了与其他转录因子二聚化并结合DNA的基础螺旋-环-螺旋（bHLH）结构域外，Ascl1还包含长的低复杂性内在无序区域（IDRs），其中包括一个功能未知的polyA/polyQ序列。在这里，我们使用单分子FRET来绘制全长Ascl1在单体、异二聚体和DNA结合状态下的构象集合。单体Ascl1大体上无序，但显示N端IDR与bHLH结构域之间的多价偶联，其中polyA/polyQ序列对抗bHLH的压缩。E12结合折叠bHLH结构域并重塑N-IDR，增加N-IDR整体的动态性，同时在polyA/polyQ序列内局部抑制动态性。删除该序列削弱Ascl1/E12异二聚体的非特异性DNA结合，而不破坏异二聚化或高亲和力E-box结合，消除体外聚集，并增加HEK293T细胞中Ascl1的丰度。因此，polyA/polyQ序列作为一个调节模块，促进非特异性DNA结合，同时以溶解性和细胞丰度为代价。
